title: ScratchPad grant reply
description: What the creator answers to a grant request, with no headers. `granted: true` means the creator made the grant itself, on its own volume: read only, the one path the reference names, its usual expiry. Anything else is a refusal with its reason in words; the requester then sends its prompt without that reference.

reason.description: with a refusal only: which line of the creator's rule refused, for the requester's log and its model
